news.title: SLU Habitat for Neighborhood Business Announces Fall 2026 Cohort
news.summary_en: SLU- HNB, Saint Louis University's program to help small entrepreneurs grow their retail and service businesses in economically-challenged neighborhoods, announces its Fall 2026 cohort.

news.title: SLU Recognizes Faculty Promotions
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University recently hosted a ceremony to kick off the new academic year and recognize faculty members who received promotions and tenure.

news.title: Saint Louis University Students Participate in Camino de SLU
news.summary_en: Ahead of the beatification Mass for Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen in St. Louis on Thursday, Sept. 24, a group of Saint Louis University students and Jesuit scholastics participated in a Camino, or walking tour of significant places, from campus to the Old Cathedral on St. Louis' riverfront, stopping at historic churches along the way.
